verdict.rationale: The README says every run is kept on the phone and can be replayed step by step with the taps and swipes drawn on top. Runs can also be exported as a trace of screenshots, actions and annotations, which covers the steps taken, the screens seen and the inputs injected. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the replay/export, explicit confirmation that typed keyboard text and model reasoning are captured, and detail on retention or trace format.
